build_MLAAttnQuantFusionPass: build an MLA attention quantization fusion pass that fuses post-attention FP8 or NVFP4 quantization onto MLA attention layers
create_MLAAttnFp8StaticQuantPattern: create an FP8 static quantization pattern matcher that fuses MLA attention output with static FP8 quantization
create_MLAAttnNvfp4QuantPattern: create an NVFP4 dynamic quantization pattern matcher that fuses MLA attention output with NVFP4 quantization
test_MLAAttnQuantFusionPass: test the MLA attention quant fusion pass to register FP8 and NVFP4 quantization patterns for supported layers
review_MLAAttnFp8StaticQuantPattern: review the FP8 static quant pattern class that matches MLA attention followed by static FP8 quant and replaces it with fused output
